# `employment`

Employment of a person by a legal entity (EMP-01). Rehire is a new employment row; history is preserved.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | people |
| Kind | aggregate-root |
| Tenant scope | Tenant scoped: `tenant_id` + row-level security, composite keys/FKs |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `employment-record`: Personnel history retained after employment ends per the legal pack and tenant policy (NFR-05, DOC-17). Period: comes from an approved pack, none exists yet. |
| API mapping | /v1/employments (planned) |
| Write path | people repository createEmployment. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0003_people (expand). Employment category / classification (EMP-04) is deliberately absent pending design (open questions). |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- FKs to person and legal_entity within the same tenant
- unique (tenant_id, legal_entity_id, employee_code)
- employee_code 1-40 chars [A-Za-z0-9._/-]
- end_date >= hire_date
- optimistic version
- audit required
